_comment: A labelled retrieval evaluation set: 22 questions a real user might ask,
each mapped to the documentation page(s) that genuinely answer it.
These labels were written by reading the FastAPI docs, not by running the
retriever and recording what it returned. That distinction is the whole
point -- a set built from your own system's output only ever confirms
'expected_docs' lists every page that would be a correct answer. A question
with two acceptable sources is not a weaker test; it is an honest one.
